standards_review.notes: Guide requires EPMCDME-####: Description for repository commits (git-workflow.md). 3 of ~38 commit subjects in the review range use a different task-slug format instead: 'teams-integ-1-foundation: add planning artifacts', 'teams-integ-2-migration: add planning artifacts', 'teams-integ-3-read-merge: add planning artifacts'. All other subjects (e.g. EPMCDME-14111:..., EPMCDME-14025:..., EPMCDME-13657:...) match the documented format.

Spot-checked the feature-relevant new/changed files (src/codemie/service/user/billing_user_resolver.py, TEAMS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID addition in src/codemie/configs/config.py, header helper and routing calls in src/codemie/rest_api/routers/assistant.py): modern typed signatures (X | None unions), docstrings present, no untyped public functions, no second formatter introduced. No violation of code-quality.md found in the areas examined.

resolve_billing_user (src/codemie/service/user/billing_user_resolver.py) does not reimplement bearer/header auth parsing itself — it consumes the already-authenticated User from the authenticate dependency and only substitutes the billing identity when caller.user_type/caller.id exactly match the allow-listed TEAMS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID, mitigating arbitrary header-based impersonation by non-service-account callers. The X-Teams-Sender-Email header value is used only as a lookup key against user_repository.get_by_email, not logged; the warning path logs only caller.id, not sender_email. No credentials or tokens are logged in the reviewed code paths.
